description: Generates a stateless, non-persistent chaos fault policy payload (mock HTTP body, simulatedLatencyMs, and retry guidance) for your test harness to simulate failures (429, 500, timeout, 401, malformed JSON) against targetToolName or 'all_tools' at failureProbability (0.01–1.0). Mutates no live tools or server state (non-idempotent only because each call emits a fresh policyId); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use to produce mock fault fixtures for resilience tests; use systemores_stress_test_agent for prompt-level adversarial testing.

failureProbability.description: Probability of fault triggering per invocation (0.01 to 1.0).

faultType.description: The specific chaos fault to inject.

targetToolName.description: Target tool name to scope the generated mock fault policy to, or 'all_tools' for any tool.

name: systemores_inject_environment_fault
title: Generate Chaos Fault Injection Policy
